name: MMBench-EN
intro: MMBench-EN 在此限定为英文 v1.0 发布，而不是 3,217 题的 v1.1。早期论文写 2,974 题；2023 年 10 月去除约 20 多道噪声题后的官方 DEV/TEST 文件实际包含 1,164 + 1,784 = 2,948 道逻辑题。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore, Zhejiang University
build_method: 三级能力体系、作者冷启动、学生志愿者扩充、纯文本可答与错题双路筛查、人工复核、2023 年 10 月去噪修订
metric: CircularEval 逻辑题准确率（总体微平均、L2/L3 分组）
eval_feature: 英文视觉问答, CircularEval, 启发式与 GPT-4-0125 选项抽取
build_method_en: Three-level taxonomy, author seeds, student-volunteer expansion, text-only and wrong-item screening with human review, and the October-2023 noise-removal revision
eval_feature_en: English Visual QA, CircularEval, heuristic and GPT-4-0125 choice extraction
intro_en: MMBench-EN is bounded here to the English v1.0 release, not the 3,217-item v1.1 dataset. Earlier paper revisions state 2,974 questions; after the October-2023 removal of roughly twenty-plus noisy items, the official DEV/TEST files contain 1,164 + 1,784 = 2,948 logical questions.
scale_en: v1.0 has 2,948 logical items; DEV 1,164 / TEST 1,784
metric_en: CircularEval logical-item accuracy (overall micro-average and L2/L3 groups)

drawio_review_note: This identity is the English v1.0 release, not MMBench v1.1. The audit pins arXiv:2307.06281v5 and repository commit 8eaac9ae42e22eaf42863b218455acd51268ba1c; historical commits 347c4854b06a87c8ed91ad6d7f3dd2b0385579da and 9d5a0d59773e38b2fb346d8a37a6e7e19148d504 record the October-2023 revision and explicit release counts. Earlier paper revisions state 2,974 questions, but the official v1.0 files contain 1,164 DEV and 1,784 TEST logical items (2,948 total). Current VLMEvalKit pins MD5 b6caf1133a01c6bb705cf753bb527ed8 for DEV and 6939fadb0ce626fefc0bdc9c64efc528 for TEST. DEV has answer labels; TEST omits them and uses official submission. The v1.0 TSV retains source and comment columns, and circularly expanded rows map to one logical item via the base index. Construction follows the 2-L1/6-L2/20-L3 taxonomy, author seeds, volunteer expansion, model-assisted text-only and wrong-item screening, and human review. Evaluation is zero-shot open generation, heuristic choice extraction, gpt-4-0125 fallback, and all-pass CircularEval. The current report code uses the micro mean of one hit per logical item overall and within L2/L3. Released judge code can retry three times and then return a random valid choice or Z. Openness is partly public because v1.0 TEST labels remain hidden, scoring uses an official service, source images have mixed provenance, and the repository Apache-2.0 license does not itself relicense those images. Formal publication evidence [site-a11m-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3285×785 (English) and 3285×785 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3283×783 and 3283×783. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
